description:
Convert an existing image to another format: target_format png/jpeg/webp/bmp/tiff/gif, quality 1-100,
max_dim (downscale the long side). File up to 20 MB. For avif and maximum compression use image_compress.
Input: exactly one of source_url (public URL, the server downloads it), upload_id (create_upload, then PUT) or data_base64 (up to 512 KB).
Output: download links (resource_link, valid for 10 min; deleted once all files of the job are downloaded) and a preview of the first image. If not done within 60 s, returns status=running and a handle: call conversion_status(handle).
Rate-limited per day; call quota_status for remaining calls.
